from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0037.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
def bb(c,tol=40,u0=0,u1=512):
    m=(np.abs(im-np.array(c)).sum(axis=2)<tol)[:,u0:u1]
    rr=np.where(m.any(axis=1))[0]; cc=np.where(m.any(axis=0))[0]
    return (u0+cc.min(),u0+cc.max(),rr.min(),rr.max())
print('blue vase',bb(im[310,160]))
print('chair brown',bb(im[280,240],40,200,290))
print('stool brown',bb(im[375,320],40,265,375))
print('lamp shade',bb(im[230,400],40,370,440))
dk=(im.sum(axis=2)<340)&(im.sum(axis=2)>150)
dk[:180,:]=False
for nm,u0,u1 in [('chairlegs',210,290),('stoollegs',265,375),('lampbase',375,445)]:
    m=dk[:,u0:u1]; rr=np.where(m.any(axis=1))[0]; cc=np.where(m.any(axis=0))[0]
    print(nm,u0+cc.min(),u0+cc.max(),rr.min(),rr.max())
" 2>/dev/null
